$schema_note: Recommended evidence-preserving Python BI reasoning patterns. These are review defaults, not executable recipes.

patterns.name: Profile before mutation
patterns.do: Record source revision, grain candidates, shape, schema, missingness, cardinality, and ranges before cleaning.

patterns.name: Coerce with a rejection ledger
patterns.do: Record invalid literals, nulls created, precision effects, and approved disposition for every conversion.

patterns.name: Declare merge cardinality
patterns.do: State both grains, verify uniqueness on the one-side, declare expected cardinality, and reconcile after merge.

patterns.name: Recompute non-additive metrics from components
patterns.do: Aggregate approved additive components to target grain and recompute ratios or averages there.

patterns.name: Parse dates under governed policy
patterns.do: Declare format, timezone, business-date cutoff, and calendar source; preserve raw values through validation.

patterns.name: Reconcile against an independent boundary
patterns.do: Match scope and compare grain, row counts, uniqueness, segment controls, and additive totals with predeclared tolerances.

patterns.name: Optimize the measured dominant stage
patterns.do: Preserve correctness, measure stage time and memory, change one cause, and re-run controls.

patterns.name: Hand evidence to the owning gate
patterns.do: Package checks, findings, blockers, owner, destination, and next action without advancing readiness.
